obligation: Operate in the EU only via authorisation, temporary-regime registration, equivalence, endorsement or recognition
evidence_expected: ESMA decision / register entry; Art 51 notification acknowledgement

obligation: Existing non-small provider: notify ESMA by 2 Aug 2026 and apply within four months of 2 Jul 2026 (2 Nov 2026) or cease; temporarily listed and may operate until decision
evidence_expected: Notification receipt; complete application file (RTS 2026/1119); ESMA Art 51 list entry

obligation: Small provider: notify and be registered before operating (existing small providers notify by 2 Nov 2026); only Art 15(1),(5),(7), 23, 24 and 32-37 apply during the regime
evidence_expected: Temporary Regime Notification; audited accounts; employment records

obligation: On ceasing to qualify as small or after 3 years: full obligations apply; apply for authorisation within 6 months
evidence_expected: Size monitoring; application filed within 6 months

obligation: Comply at all times with authorisation conditions; notify ESMA without undue delay of material changes incl. opening or closing an EU branch
evidence_expected: Change log; ESMA notifications; materiality assessment

obligation: Endorsement of same-group non-EU ratings: EU substance (premises, bank account, analytical presence), objective reason, endorsed ratings meet requirements at least as stringent as ESGR, monitoring expertise; endorser fully responsible
evidence_expected: Endorsement application (RTS 2026/1119 Annex IV); ongoing monitoring of endorsed ratings

obligation: Recognition only if turnover below the small-undertaking ceiling for each of last 3 years (no equivalence decision): EU legal representative, Annex I info, list of EU ratings; notify within 3 months and apply for authorisation within 12 months if thresholds exceeded
evidence_expected: Recognition file (RTS 2026/1119 Annex III); CSV of ratings for EU distribution

obligation: Ensure independence of rating activities, incl. from political and economic influence
evidence_expected: Independence policy; governance minutes; conflict register

obligation: Rules and procedures so ratings are issued, published and distributed in line with the Regulation
evidence_expected: Procedure manual; process maps; control matrix

obligation: Adequate and effective systems, resources and procedures
evidence_expected: Resourcing plan; system inventory; procedures

obligation: Written policies so ratings rest on thorough analysis of all relevant information, consistent with methodologies
evidence_expected: Analytical policy; rating files showing information considered

obligation: Internal due-diligence policies so business interests do not impair independence or accuracy
evidence_expected: Due-diligence policy; commercial/analytical separation evidence

obligation: Sound administrative and accounting procedures, internal controls, safeguards for information-processing systems
evidence_expected: ICS documentation; ITGC evidence (access, change, operations)

obligation: Methodologies rigorous, systematic, independent and justifiable; applied continuously and transparently
evidence_expected: Methodology documents; reproducibility tests; consistency checks across rated items

obligation: Review methodologies on an ongoing basis and at least annually
evidence_expected: Annual review records with conclusions and sign-off

obligation: Monitor and evaluate adequacy and effectiveness of systems at least annually; remediate deficiencies
evidence_expected: Annual effectiveness assessment; remediation tracker

obligation: Permanent, independent, effective oversight function with resources, expertise, information access and direct access to management body
evidence_expected: Oversight charter; reporting lines; reports to management body

obligation: Use information of sufficient quality from reliable sources; state the rating is the provider's own opinion
evidence_expected: Data-source register; data-quality controls; opinion disclaimer on outputs

obligation: Notify rated item/issuer in working hours at least two full working days before first issuance; on request provide Annex III info, last data-update date and relevant data free of charge
evidence_expected: Notification log with timestamps; contact-search records; access-request handling; issuance timestamps

obligation: Change ratings only in accordance with published methodologies
evidence_expected: Rating-change log linked to methodology version; exception reports

obligation: Do not provide consulting, credit ratings, benchmarks, investment services, statutory audit/assurance, credit/insurance activities (subject to 16(2)-(3))
evidence_expected: Activity inventory; legal-entity map

obligation: If doing investment services or insurance: autonomy, no decision conflicts, assessment staff not involved; consider group
evidence_expected: Separation design; RTS 2026/872 Art 2 measures

obligation: Benchmarks only with ESMA authorisation of measures; notify substantial changes beforehand
evidence_expected: ESMA decision; change notifications

obligation: Assessment staff do not provide consulting, credit rating or audit/assurance

obligation: Refrain from other services that create conflict-of-interest risks
evidence_expected: Service inventory with conflict assessment

obligation: Decision/reporting structures excluding assessment staff; dedicated workspaces; annual staff self-declaration
evidence_expected: Org chart; floor plan or workspace allocation; signed declarations

obligation: Role-based access controls; data classification and watermarking; training; compliance monitoring; adequacy review at least every 24 months
evidence_expected: Access-control matrix; classification policy; training logs; 24-month review report

obligation: Benchmark providers: remuneration safeguards; ratings not mechanically reliant on own benchmark constituents/outputs; pre-contract conflict documentation
evidence_expected: Remuneration policy; methodology independence analysis; contract conflict checks

obligation: Staff appropriately trained and experienced
evidence_expected: Training records; competency matrix

obligation: Staff do not negotiate fees with rated items or issuers

obligation: Personal-trading bans and recusal for holdings or relationships in the last year

obligation: Protect records; confidentiality; no use of confidential info; no gifts or favours
evidence_expected: Confidentiality and gifts policies; gifts register

obligation: Immediate internal reporting of apparently illegal conduct; no retaliation

obligation: Outsourcing does not impair internal control or ESMA supervision; provider remains responsible

obligation: Disclose ownership chart, fee-setting criteria, business model and revenue split, main conflict areas

obligation: Robust governance and clear roles; all steps so no rating is affected by conflicts

obligation: Disclose to ESMA all existing or potential conflicts incl. from ownership or control

obligation: Staff skills and supervision; no undue influence; remuneration not conflicting; no compromising interests; no trading contributions; information-exchange controls

obligation: Cooperate with ESMA information requests, investigations and on-site inspections
